title: Salvage Corps, human designed, entirely AI crafted.
author: Big-Bag-7504
selftext:
Hi!  
I used to develop flash games way back in the old flash gaming days, when it all died I got a job as a software engineer and stopped, this new Vibe coding and AI assisted game development situation really got me interested in seeing how far I could push it.   
This game was created without me touching a single line of code, not even a config myself, if I knew what the problem was I explained it so that the agent would learn and remember. What I did do was hold my agent's hands through the process, design the systems and explain how I wanted them implemented.   
I'd never created an action game before and I felt like an extraction/Survivors type game could be a bunch of fun, all sorts of POIs to explore and loot to find and extract with to re-equip and try and push further.  
In total it took about a month, I'm currently working on a premium steam version using the same techniques which has taken about 3 months so far but is head and shoulder above this one, it might as well be a prototype.  
  
I'm really happy with the results though and am pursuing a bunch more ideas, but felt this was a good one to share. It's up over on Crazy Games now: [https://www.crazygames.com/game/salvage-corps-fuz](https://www.crazygames.com/game/salvage-corps-fuz)

comments.author: ZymzAlchemy
comments.body: A fellow vector graphics enthusiast. I dig the vibe.

replies.author: Big-Bag-7504
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/yebkgqi4g3kh1.png?width=511&format=png&auto=webp&s=a7d10abb78f62e0ec467f7cc4af0e3e6ebc12829

Yeah, I figured early that getting AI to create art for the game was a minefield, but teaching it how to use the graphics API to draw art from basic primitives was actually a winner in my mind. I dial this up to 11 in the premium version I'm working on.  
The graphics is still all entirely "hand drawn" by AI from primitives just a LOT more of them :)

comments.author: systemsweird
comments.body: Very cool. I’ve always loved dual stick shooters so I was a bit bummed it was auto aim but otherwise really like the concept. Geometry wars is one my favorite games of all time, so I definitely love any 2D shooters like this.

comments.author: leeroycharles
comments.body: What did you use to make it?

replies.author: Big-Bag-7504
replies.body: Typescript with PIXI v8 as a codebase - I don't like how much footprint Unity etc bundles into games so this way it has a super small footprint and only ships what it needs.
